title: Spectral Characterisation of Covariance Existence in Markov-Switching Affine Recurrences
summary: This paper provides a finite-dimensional spectral characterisation for when the stationary covariance matrix of a finite-state Markov-switching affine recurrence exists. For stochastic recurrences of the form \[ Z_{n+1}=A_{Θ_{n+1}}Z_n+ζ_{n+1}, \] strict stationarity is typically governed by negativity of the top Lyapunov exponent of the random matrix products. This condition, however, does not ensure that the stationary law has finite variances, covariances, and Pearson correlations.
